domain: Subtracting fractions, mixed numbers, and whole numbers with regrouping and simplification

skills.name: Find common denominator
skills.definition: Determine a common denominator and rewrite fractional parts as equivalent fractions before subtraction when the denominators do not already match.
inclusion_criteria: Tag when a step explicitly finds an LCD or common denominator.
Tag when one or both fractions are converted to equivalent fractions with a shared denominator before subtracting.
Tag for mixed-number subtraction when only the fractional parts are aligned by denominator conversion.
exclusion_criteria: Do not tag when denominators already match and no conversion is performed.
Do not tag subtraction of numerators after common denominators are already established.
Do not tag rewriting a whole number as a mixed number with 0 over a denominator unless equivalent-fraction conversion is also being performed.

skills.name: Rewrite operands
skills.definition: Rewrite a whole number or nonstandard mixed number into subtraction-ready mixed-number form, such as adding a zero fractional part or normalizing an improper fractional part.
inclusion_criteria: Tag when a whole number is rewritten as a mixed number like 3 + 0/5 or 2 + 0/8.
Tag when a mixed number with an improper fractional part is normalized, such as 2 3/2 to 3 1/2.
Tag when this rewriting prepares the quantities for later whole-part and fraction-part subtraction.
exclusion_criteria: Do not tag ordinary equivalent-fraction conversion used only to create a common denominator.
Do not tag borrowing from the whole part during subtraction.
Do not tag final recombination of whole and fractional parts.

skills.name: Subtract aligned parts
skills.definition: Subtract fractions with a common denominator and/or subtract whole-number and fractional parts separately once the quantities are in compatible form.
inclusion_criteria: Tag when numerators are subtracted over a shared denominator.
Tag when whole parts and fraction parts of mixed numbers are subtracted separately after setup is complete.
Tag when a step computes an intermediate negative fractional difference before any borrowing step.
exclusion_criteria: Do not tag finding a common denominator or converting to equivalent fractions.
Do not tag the borrowing or regrouping step itself.
Do not tag simplification of the resulting fraction or integer.

skills.name: Borrow in subtraction
skills.definition: Regroup one whole as fractional units and adjust the whole part when the fractional part of the minuend is too small to subtract the fractional part of the subtrahend.
inclusion_criteria: Tag when a step explicitly borrows 1 from the whole part.
Tag when the borrowed whole is converted into denominator-sized fractional units such as 3/3, 10/10, or 24/24.
Tag when regrouping resolves a negative fractional difference in mixed-number or whole-minus-fraction subtraction.
exclusion_criteria: Do not tag ordinary subtraction when no regrouping is needed.
Do not tag rewriting a whole number as having fractional part 0 before any need to borrow is addressed.
Do not tag simplification after subtraction.

skills.name: Simplify result
skills.definition: Reduce the subtraction result to lowest terms or convert a zero-valued fraction to 0 or an equivalent integer form when appropriate.
inclusion_criteria: Tag when a fraction is explicitly reduced, such as 2/10 to 1/5 or 9/12 to 3/4.
Tag when 0 over a denominator is simplified to 0.
Tag when the final result is expressed in lowest terms after subtraction.
exclusion_criteria: Do not tag subtraction steps that already produce a lowest-term fraction with no explicit simplification action shown.
Do not tag combining whole and fractional parts unless reduction is explicitly performed there.
Do not tag normalization of operands before subtraction.

skills.name: Compose final answer
skills.definition: Combine the computed whole-number and fractional parts into a single final value in mixed-number, fraction, or integer form.
inclusion_criteria: Tag when separate whole and fractional results are recombined into one final number.
Tag when a zero whole part is omitted to present a proper fraction.
Tag when a whole part plus zero fraction is expressed as an integer.
exclusion_criteria: Do not tag the subtraction computations that produce the parts.
Do not tag simplification alone unless the step's main action is recombination.
Do not tag setup steps such as normalization, denominator alignment, or borrowing.
